headline: Exchange Outflow Widens To 953.0 Million Dollars From 558.7 Million
narrative: Clean-asset outflow across 79 exchanges widened to 953.0 million dollars from 558.7 million dollars, equal to 0.3548 percent of the 268.6 billion dollars held on those venues. A positive pipe is dollars arriving on the venue, sell-side supply, and a negative pipe is dollars leaving, measured as the 24-hour change in holdings excluding each exchange's own token. Binance sent out 793.0 million dollars, up from 427.4 million dollars, Bybit sent out 90.3 million dollars, and Crypto.com sent out 34.1 million dollars, while Bitfinex took in 39.5 million dollars.
author: jordan
